newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boston Chicken cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boston Chicken cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Thursday it lowered its rating for Boston Chicken Inc to hold from buy to reflect expectations that first-quarter economic gains will be lower than Hanifen originally expected.

-- Hanifen said the relatively disappointing sales of the fast food chain's Extreme Carver line extensions demonstrate that the comapny may be more vulnerable than originally anticipated compared with promotional programs of its competitors.
-- Boston Chicken may face continuing pressure over the near term as the sector feels the impact of extensive discounting programs being run by other fast food comapnies.
-- Boston Chicken shares were off 3/8 Thursday at 26-1/2.
